title: Missing audit events and ignored audit setting
difficulty_rationale: Two independent root causes across six modules; one failure is silent because the event bus isolates handler exceptions, so the defect must be traced through the bus, the user service and the audit handler.
summary: User deletions never reach the audit log, and 'audit.enabled = false' in the settings file does not disable auditing.
required_behavior: Every user lifecycle event (created, renamed, deleted) publishes a payload that follows the documented schema in app/events.py.
With auditing enabled, each lifecycle event produces exactly one audit entry with the correct event name, user id and name.
audit.enabled and audit.include_names accept true/false/yes/no/on/off/1/0 (case-insensitive); any other value raises ValueError.
With auditing disabled, no audit entries are produced.
No handler errors are recorded on the bus during normal operation.

acceptance_tests.description: create, rename and delete each produce one audit entry.
user.deleted payload contains user_id and name.
The bus records no handler errors.
